models.pcfm: H3 PCFM (poly_degree=3, egn=True, edge_fix=True, cache_spans=True), EDFA only
models.raman_lumped: H3 PCFM + lumped span-end Raman gain; intra-span NLI unchanged
models.hybrid_raman_paper: Buglia 2024 hybrid, Eq. (2)/(4) ODE + Eq. (6)-(9) closed form
models.hybrid_raman_paper_pcfm: Buglia ODE profile + PCFM SCI/XCI kernels (profile-only control)
models.pcfm_h3_raman: this work: H3 PCFM kernels on a coarse coupled profile and ASE
models.buglia2024_ra_gn: Buglia 2024 RA-GN closed form (paper reference group)

profile_awareness.note: lumped keeps the NLI at the no-pump value for both directions; the profile-aware model raises it for a forward pump (gain at the span input), where the error of lumped is several dB. The 1-span FW/BW results are also within 0.15 dB of hybrid_raman_paper.

notes: The reported SNR error against hybrid_raman_paper at 10 spans includes the paper's unpublished epsilon=0 (power-sum) span convention; pcfm_h3_raman defaults to the H3 visibility-weighted coherent accumulation, which matches the numerical reference. Use span_coherence='incoherent' for a paper-matched absolute comparison.
raman_effect_error_db isolates the Raman profile/ASE change by subtracting each model's own no-pump baseline.
Timing is a single-process wall clock; the paper models are slow (seconds) and are included only as references, not as deployment candidates.
